messages:
Nina R: Heads-up: SI partner onboarding asks for a packaged observability playbook for the cloud marketplace entry. goal: clear steps so SIs can enable Datadog + OTEL for our HW images.
Omar H: good call. what must the playbook include?
Nina R: minimum: OTEL collector example, trace-to-metric mapping, sample dashboard JSON, disk/retention runbook, and a short demo script.
Tess Y: we should also include a small troubleshooting section for high-cardinality tags and guidance on when to fall back to metric-only aggregation.
Ravi P: agree. partner specifically asked about including model_version, batch_size, and quant_profile as span attributes. quant_profile needs conditional emission.
Omar H: propose: emit quant_profile only when it's not "baseline_fp16" and tag batch_size as an int attribute. add a note about cardinality on model_version if partners deploy many variants.
Tess Y: sampling policy request from SI: default 5% sampling, but 100% for errors and traces where latency > 600ms. OTEL tail_sampling covers that. i'll draft a config snippet.
Nina R: please keep snippets minimal. include environment variable placeholders for DD keys. also include a small Datadog example metric query linking to traces.
Ravi P: adding a quick dd query: `avg:trace.inference.latency{model:resnet*}.rollup(p50)` and note `dd.trace_id` in logs for linking.
Tess Y: OTEL snippet (minimal):
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
      - name: error_policy
        type: string_attribute
        string_attribute:
          key: "error"
          values: ["true"]
      - name: slow_policy
        type: latency
        latency:
          threshold_ms: 600
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}
```
Omar H: runbook note: rotate and compress OTEL files, recommend retention 7d for traces, 30d for metrics. warn about /var/lib/otel growth under high sampling.
Nina R: we'll also provide a tiny demo workload generator to simulate mixed batch_size and seq_len so partners can validate dashboards. Ravi, can you point to the repo?
Ravi P: repo: https://git.internal/redwood/partner-telemetry-demo, script at /bin/spike_load.sh. includes env toggles for batch_size.
deploy-bot: Calendar: 'SI observability dry run' Tue 09:00 PT created. attendees: Nina R, Omar H, Tess Y, Ravi P.
Tess Y: i'll draft the dashboard JSON and include a small tile set: p50,p95, error_rate, and qps. naming convention: `Marketplace / <SI-name> / Model / <model_version> / Inference`
Omar H: sounds good. Nina, i'll assemble the zip for the marketplace with the playbook + dashboard + demo link.
Nina R: perfect. i'll open the marketplace PR after the dry run and loop in legal for the announcement blurb. thanks team :rocket:
